serviceDescription: MARFI is a US-based team that provides IT, cybersecurity, compliance, and secure AI services to companies in regulated industries. As a FedRAMP advisor, MARFI helps cloud service providers get ready for FedRAMP: compliance readiness reviews, internal audits and gap analysis against FedRAMP and NIST requirements, remediation planning, and preparation of security documentation and evidence. MARFI can also help providers move faster through its Launchpad DIB product, a done-for-you, managed enclave that MARFI implements and operates on government cloud platforms, with defense in depth and zero trust controls and a 24/7 security operations center. MARFI is an advisory service. It does not perform independent FedRAMP assessments and does not endorse or guarantee any FedRAMP outcome.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Compliance readiness reviews and roadmaps for cloud service providers preparing for FedRAMP.
Internal audits and gap analyses against FedRAMP and NIST SP 800-53 and 800-171 requirements, with prioritized remediation plans.

Done-for-you managed enclave implemented and operated by MARFI to help providers accelerate preparation, with defense in depth, zero trust, and multicloud support across Azure, AWS GovCloud, and Google Cloud.
Round-the-clock monitoring, managed detection and response, vulnerability and exposure management, and incident response and recovery.
Support preparing system security plans, plans of action and milestones (POA&M), policies, and audit-ready evidence packages.
Ongoing control operation and evidence collection to keep providers ready between assessments.
US-based managed IT, device management, and identity and access (single sign-on) for regulated environments.
Virtual CISO guidance for regulated and defense industrial base companies.
Scoping, implementation, and evidence for defense industrial base companies.
AI governance, acceptable use, model, vendor and data-flow review for regulated organizations.
